channel.title: Sandbox
channel.description: Sandbox is where the designers of the Dreamrules varient for the Dune board game talk about their designs and love for the game. Sandbox is hosted by Pine (IHasPinecone) and Awptea (Awpteamoose), with requent guests Chron and Ridwan and many other members of the Drearules community. Dune was originally published by Avalon Hill in 1979 and later reprinted by Gale Force Nine in 2019.
channel.itunes:author: IHasPinecone

item.title: Dune Feels Like A First Draft
item.description:
<![CDATA[

In this episode Pine and Awptea talk about their love of dune and how the game feels like a first draft more than a professionally published game

The faction sheets and rulebook for Dreamrules can be found here https://pinecone.rodeo/bg/dreamrules.html and in the Dune Tabletop Discord (link)

Pine's Website: https://pinecone.rodeo

All music and sound effects by Stéphane Picq and Philippe Ulrich for Dune (1992) for MSDOS Cryo Interactive and Dune—Spice Opera (1992)
